content.short: Theta is a purpose-built L1 blockchain for video, AI, and entertainment, featuring a decentralized edge cloud.
content.description: Theta Network is a leading decentralized video delivery and AI computing platform, designed to provide high-performance infrastructure for the entertainment industry. The network utilizes a dual structure consisting of the Theta Blockchain for settlement and the Theta Edge Network, a distributed web of nodes that provide GPU compute power for transcoding and AI tasks. Powered by the THETA governance token and TFUEL utility token, the protocol features a robust framework for content ownership. Theta serves as a vital infrastructure layer for media companies and creators.
content.meta: Theta Network provides a decentralized Layer 1 blockchain and edge cloud for video, AI, and entertainment. Discover Theta on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
